name: io.github.newmathphys/kern
title: KERN — zero-trust verification gateway
description: Zero-trust verification gateway: Z3 + a native Zig proof-DAG checker (trusted steps 0), Belnap B4 logic, Lean 4 soundness theorems, and zero-annotation X-ray for Python, Zig, C, Rust, Go and TS/JS.

tools.name: kern_verify_smt
tools.description: Verify an SMT-LIB2 contract with KERN: an external Z3 run plus an independent proof-DAG checker. Returns the verdict (proven / not proven) and a checker summary.

tools.name: kern_prove_with_checker
tools.description: Same as kern_verify_smt, but returns the FULL proof-checker breakdown: how many Z3 proof steps were re-checked independently and how many were left trusted.

annotations.title: Prove and machine-check a proof DAG

tools.name: kern_verify_multi_belnap
tools.description: Verify MULTIPLE contracts and join the verdicts in Belnap B4 (T/F/B/N). A conflict (T and F together) yields B: the contradiction is never collapsed into a proof.

annotations.title: Verify several claims in Belnap B4

tools.name: kern_verify_python
tools.description: Verify Python code carrying contracts in comments (`# @kern:requires` / `# @kern:ensures`). Branches if/elif/else and local assignments are supported: they are translated into SMT `ite`. For each function the status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP), the Belnap verdict and a COUNTEREXAMPLE on violation are returned. Loops and calls yield an honest SKIP.

tools.name: kern_check_equivalence
tools.description: Prove refactoring EQUIVALENCE without writing any contracts: for same-named functions of two sources it checks `∃x: f_old(x) != f_new(x)`. UNSAT -> [EQUIVALENT] (behaviour unchanged), SAT -> [DIVERGED] plus a COUNTEREXAMPLE where the old and new functions disagree. Loops/calls yield an honest SKIP.

tools.name: kern_xray_code
tools.description: ZERO-ANNOTATION code X-ray: dead branches [DEAD BRANCH] (UNSAT), redundant guards [REDUNDANT GUARD], crash paths [CRASH PATH] (division by zero, overflow) and McCabe complexity. Works with no @kern: annotation at all.

annotations.title: Zero-annotation X-ray of any code file

tools.name: kern_verify_action
tools.description: FinOps / Action Firewall: evaluates an agent's JSON tool call against a policy BEFORE execution. T -> 200, F -> 422 (with a counterexample), B -> 409 (the policies contradict each other).

annotations.title: Verify an AI agent action against policy

tools.name: kern_rlvr_reward
tools.description: RLVR reward oracle: +1.0 for a PROVEN contract (trusted: 0), -1.0 for a counterexample, -2.0 for reward hacking, 0.0 when abstaining (outside the supported fragment).
